Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

- OMs, dated 3-11-2004, 19-9-2005 and 25-2-2009.  
In respect of Group 'C' and 'D' officials, the Secretary of the Borrowing Authority/ Administrative Department can approve the extension of deputation period for the 4th year or the first year beyond the normal period of deputation and thereafter by the Minister of borrowing department subject to other conditions. - OM, dated 7-1-2008.
